requirements.requirement: The system must classify the lead sponsor into one of the following types: university, hospital, pharma, or unknown based on institution name patterns.
The system must normalize funding_source into one of: public (NIH/NCI/government), industry, or undisclosed using ClinicalTrials.gov input values.
The system must assign a positive credibility score when sponsor_type is university or hospital and funding_source is public.
The system must assign a negative credibility score when sponsor_type is unknown and funding_source is undisclosed.
The system must assign a neutral or moderately positive score when sponsor_type is pharma and funding_source is industry.
The system must incorporate collaborator institutions into scoring by increasing credibility when at least one collaborator is classified as university or hospital.
The system must not double-count credibility contributions when multiple collaborators share the same classification.
The system must produce a deterministic credibility score for the same input data across repeated executions.
The system must handle missing lead_sponsor data by assigning sponsor_type as unknown and applying fallback scoring rules.
The system must handle missing funding_source data by classifying it as undisclosed and applying corresponding scoring rules.
The system must generate a transparency_flag set to false when funding_source is undisclosed and true otherwise.
The system must output a structured explanation string describing how sponsor_type, funding_source, and collaborators contributed to the final score.
The system must cap the credibility score within a predefined bounded range (e.g., 0 to 1 or -1 to 1).
The system must default to a neutral score when both sponsor_type and funding_source cannot be determined and no collaborators are present.
